author: Johnny Potter

title: Review after one year
body:
This is a great app until you start using it.

Sync - in one word - nighmare. Everybody complains, but there is no development in this. You cant easyli sync data, especially historical data if you off for a few days. There is no push data button to send it all, you have to do tricks and hacks to keep sync alive, it updates usually what you dont need (stress ie) but no steps, floors.. why not to send it all in one package?

Friends - good to compete them, but only in steps?!? Why not to beat them in floors, sports (swimming, run, cycling)? To add a friend is sometimes run for a long distance.

Monthly challenges - still a lot users cheating with steps, no one cares. Useless and dissapointing to compete fake users who runs like Bolt even they sleeping.

Updates - in one year any significant updates to make the app better. Missing new ideas, tip and tricks to be more active.

Historical data - hard to get easy information about my progress, compare my KPIs, go thru journeys (ie with friends, family).

If this is a work of official support of Samsung.. its a crap :(

body:

Lately I had an issue with transferring data after reconnecting to a new iOS device. The steps history dissappeared, although in achievements it is still present. Another tracked activity trends are still visible in the history.

This app is far from well build kind of applications, but unfortunately it can’t be replaced by another. I am terribly confused and move myself asap to iOS wearables.
